name: codeant
description: Drive CodeAnt AI security scans and code review from Claude — org-wide secret triage, cross-repo SAST/SCA findings, on-demand scans, and local PR review.
long_description:
CodeAnt AI inside Claude. Ask things like "show my highest-priority Hotlist findings", "list AWS cloud findings", "show this pentest report", or "review my staged changes" — Claude calls the CodeAnt API directly via this MCP server.

Includes 23 read-only tools, including repository, Hotlist, cloud security, anti-pattern, and pentest findings plus an authenticated GET escape hatch for new APIs, and 3 opt-in write tools gated behind a setting.

Requires a CodeAnt account. Sign up at https://codeant.ai. To authenticate, call the `codeant_login` tool — it opens the CodeAnt sign-in page in your browser and saves the token automatically.

Collects anonymous usage telemetry via PostHog by default; set CODEANT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 to opt out.

tools.name: codeant_scans_orgs
tools.description: List the CodeAnt organizations the current user is authenticated to.

tools.name: codeant_scans_repos
tools.description: List repositories connected to CodeAnt for an organization.

tools.name: codeant_scans_history
tools.description: Show recent scan runs for a single repository.

tools.name: codeant_scans_get
tools.description: Get summary metadata for a single scan (no findings).

tools.name: codeant_scans_results
tools.description: Fetch full findings (SAST, SCA, secrets, IaC, etc.) for a scan.

tools.name: codeant_scans_dismissed
tools.description: List dismissed alerts for a repository.

tools.name: codeant_hotlist_list
tools.description: List prioritized organization-wide Hotlist findings with stable IDs.

tools.name: codeant_hotlist_get
tools.description: Fetch one complete Hotlist finding by its stable ID.

tools.name: codeant_findings_antipatterns
tools.description: List anti-pattern findings across selected or all organization repositories.

tools.name: codeant_cloud_scan_history
tools.description: List AWS, Azure, or GCP CSPM, VM, or container scan history.

tools.name: codeant_cloud_findings_list
tools.description: List findings for a CSPM, VM, or container security scan.

tools.name: codeant_cloud_finding_get
tools.description: Fetch complete detail for one cloud security finding.

tools.name: codeant_pentest_history
tools.description: List pentest engagements visible in CodeAnt.

tools.name: codeant_pentest_issues
tools.description: List all available issues for a pentest engagement.

tools.name: codeant_pentest_report
tools.description: Fetch a complete pentest customer report.

tools.name: codeant_api_get
tools.description: Call any authenticated GET endpoint on the configured CodeAnt API host.

tools.name: codeant_pr_list
tools.description: List pull requests / merge requests across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps.

tools.name: codeant_pr_get
tools.description: Fetch detailed information for a single PR/MR.

tools.name: codeant_pr_comments
tools.description: List comments on a PR/MR with optional filters.

tools.name: codeant_comments_search
tools.description: Search across CodeAnt review comments by free-text query.

tools.name: codeant_review_local
tools.description: Run a CodeAnt AI review on local working-copy changes.

tools.name: codeant_login
tools.description: Open app.codeant.ai in the browser and poll until the user completes sign-in; saves the resulting API token.

tools.name: codeant_logout
tools.description: Clear the saved API token and sign out of CodeAnt AI.

tools.name: codeant_scans_start
tools.description: Trigger a new scan run (write — gated behind read_only=false).

tools.name: codeant_pr_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a PR conversation thread (write — gated behind read_only=false).

tools.name: codeant_api_request
tools.description: Call an authenticated POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE API (write — gated behind read_only=false).

api_token.title: CodeAnt API token
api_token.description: Optional. Leave blank and call the `codeant_login` tool to sign in through your browser.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: Override only if you are on a self-hosted CodeAnt instance.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: When enabled, write tools (trigger scan, resolve PR thread) are hidden. Recommended.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Personal access token for GitHub. Also accepts the GH_TOKEN environment variable. Leave blank to fall back to the gh CLI.

gitlab_token.title: GitLab token
gitlab_token.description: Personal access token for GitLab. Leave blank to fall back to the glab CLI.

bitbucket_token.title: Bitbucket token
bitbucket_token.description: App password or access token for Bitbucket.

azure_devops_token.title: Azure DevOps token
azure_devops_token.description: Personal access token for Azure DevOps. Also accepts AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT.

github_api_url.title: GitHub API URL
github_api_url.description: Override for GitHub Enterprise Server (e.g. https://github.example.com/api/v3). Leave blank for GitHub.com.

gitlab_url.title: GitLab URL
gitlab_url.description: Override for a self-hosted GitLab instance (e.g. https://gitlab.example.com). Leave blank for GitLab.com.

bitbucket_url.title: Bitbucket URL
bitbucket_url.description: Override for a self-hosted Bitbucket Server instance. Leave blank for Bitbucket Cloud.

azure_devops_org_url.title: Azure DevOps organization URL
azure_devops_org_url.description: Full URL to your Azure DevOps organization (e.g. https://dev.azure.com/myorg).
